title: [ALAppExtensions #30250] Matrix Management: reorder OnFormatRoundingFactor Signature
summary: The OnAfterSetAmountDecimal event in Matrix Management codeunit has its parameters reordered so AmountDecimal appears first, aligning with related events. This requires external subscribers to update their parameter order.
key_points: Parameter order of OnAfterSetAmountDecimal event changed to put AmountDecimal first
Aligns event signature consistency with related events
No runtime behavior change, pure refactor
External event subscribers must update parameter order
No table schema or data upgrade impact
